title: Audit the selected kernel's display-query import ABI
goal: Exercise actual selected-kernel display-query exports through original synthetic guest callbacks before any GPU service admission, separating observed query ABI behavior from unbacked display/engine controls and unknown retail semantics.
acceptance: Bind exact approved lifecycle-repaired SDK/source, export ordinal/name/function-module, prototype/layout and compiler identities; inspect the pinned implementation and define independent byte-level serialization/canary expectations with retail and alternate-mode unknowns explicit

Invoke actual VdQueryVideoMode, VdGetCurrentDisplayInformation, VdGetCurrentDisplayGamma and VdQueryVideoFlags export wrappers from original bounded synthetic guest-thread contexts; verify output extent/endian handling, returned flag placement, permitted register effects and owned runtime cleanup without compiling kernel objects or using success stubs

Exercise valid output geometry/order, guarded or invalid guest output boundaries in isolated owned subprocesses, wrong-result and incomplete/deadline controls; retain successes, faults, deviations and inconclusive expectations separately rather than declaring full console compatibility

Classify adjacent success-valued no-op/stub display and engine controls from exact source without admitting or presenting them as functioning rendering; change no SDK, shared runtime interface, GPU packet/shader path, guarded startup harness or service allowlist
validation: Run repeated original query/canary cases on native Windows/Linux and supported host/core sanitizer profiles using actual loaded SDK module identities; use lifecycle-repaired packages and private per-attempt profiles/output/process ownership

Run meaningful positive/negative protocol, receipt/source/library/result checks and public platform suites; preserve failed attempts and explicit missing console-reference, alternative-mode and graphics/debug-layer evidence

Measure comparable query/dispatch and teardown distributions over at least three independent processes, with timer/instrumentation/cache limits and unknown weighted MW3 architecture scores; this audit alone passes no title, GPU service, first-frame or gameplay gate
size: bounded game-free display-query ABI audit with retained defects; separate tasks required for SDK repairs, mode injection, GPU service admission or title adoption
